reasons: The target is materially different from the completed grapheme-budget seam: it concerns touch-visible evidence access on the existing native detail surface.
The repair composes the existing heartbeatDetail owner and existing HeartbeatEvidenceDetailProjection rather than creating parallel detail architecture.
A bounded-height scrollable viewport preserves overlay geometry while allowing the exact projected detail to remain inspectable instead of destructively ellipsized.
The plan preserves explicit-selection TalkBack behavior and forbids changes to automatic/collapsed speech, motion, checkpointing, P0, and phone ownership.
The new interaction topology materially justifies an in-place non-raster source-art mutation.
watch_for: ScrollingMovementMethod accidentally replacing full TalkBack content with a visual-only projection.
A scroll surface smaller than the existing 48dp touch contract.
Unbounded wrap-content growth that lets evidence consume the overlay.
Changing detail text identity, mute behavior, automatic announcements, or collapsed-owner speech while fixing visual inspection.
Claiming runtime scrolling/TalkBack behavior from source wiring alone.
